The repair uses the complete flatness criterion on the torsion-free integral model instead, and obtains the generic-fibre flatness as a corollary.
proofSteps: Since g_k belongs to the base and j ≥ k, the reduction of f_{ik} in Z = T^{1/p^j} is the monic polynomial Z^{p^{j−k}}−g_k. Hence f_{ik} has Gauss norm 1. The base Gauss norm is multiplicative, so multiplication by f_{ik} is isometric, and RA.2 Weierstrass gives the torsion-free unit-ball quotient C.

The Noetherian restricted-power-series quotient is ϖ_j-adically complete. Its reduction is (A°_{j0}/ϖ_j)[Z,U]/(Z^{p^{j−k}}−g_k), with the explicit free basis {Z^a U^b : 0 ≤ a < p^{j−k}, b ≥ 0}. The basis contains 1, so the reduction is faithfully flat.

Bhatt's flatness criterion (DerivedDeRhamCohomology:DD.1/ordinary-flatness-from-complete-flatness) with π = ϖ_j gives faithful flatness of A°_{j0} → C: A°_{j0} is Noetherian, both rings are ϖ_j-torsion-free and complete, and the reduction is faithfully flat (free and nonzero, its fibre over the closed point being k[T^{1/p^j}, U]/(f̄) with f̄ not a unit).
Inverting p gives the flatness of the generic fibre over A_{j0} that André B asserts in step (a).

The hypothesis g_k ∈ A°_{j0} is essential: if g_k = T^{1/p^k} in the auxiliary Tate algebra and f_{ik} = 0, the quotient has nonzero ϖ_j-torsion and is not flat. If j < k the displayed monomial is not even in the indicated stage.

For a fixed k, obtain g_k by Frobenius surjectivity on the completed coordinate base Â°_∞0 modulo a sufficiently small pseudouniformizer, then approximate it in a finite base stage and enlarge j ≥ k. No dependence on the auxiliary T is needed.

nodes.title: André's flatness theorem for the Kummer tower
nodes.statement: In the setting of PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/normalized-kummer-tower, in the almost setup (K°_∞, K°°_∞) (equivalently (A°_∞0, K°°_∞A°_∞0)), the p-adically completed Kummer tower Â°_∞∞ is almost faithfully flat over the decompleted coordinate tower A°_∞0. Moreover, for each i the unit ball of the tube Â_∞0⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩{(T − g)/ϖ^i} is almost faithfully flat over A°_∞0, and its image under (·)_{!!} is a faithfully flat A°_∞0-algebra.
hypotheses: Only the statement modulo powers of p is needed for the applications; this avoids the subtleties of completions and the final reduction to the Noetherian case (André B Remarque 2.6.1(4)).

The method extends to finitely many elements g^{(1)}, …, g^{(m)} with variables T^{(1)}, …, T^{(m)}, and to a ramified complete regular local base of mixed characteristic with perfect residue field (André B Remarque 2.6.1(4)).
proofSteps: Fix ϖ ∈ K̂°_∞ with |p| ≤ |ϖ| < 1 and roots, and ϖ′ ∈ K°_∞ with |ϖ| < |ϖ′| < 1. By the approximation lemma (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/approximation-lemma) choose f_i ∈ Â°_∞0⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩ with compatible roots, f_i ≡ T − g mod ϖ′, and the same tube: Â_∞0⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩{(T − g)/ϖ^i}° ≅ Â_∞0⟨T^{1/p^∞}⟩{f_i/ϖ^i}° (formula (11)).

By the explicit almost integral model of rational localisations (PerfectoidSpaces:P2/almost-integral-model-of-untilted-rational-localization) and the Weierstrass unit-ball theorem, the almost unit ball is the completed colimit over k of Â°_∞0⟨T^{1/p^∞}, U⟩/(ϖ^{i/p^k}U − f_i^{1/p^k}) (formulas (12)–(13)).

Each term does not change when f_i^{1/p^k} is replaced by f_{ik} ∈ A°_{j0}⟨T^{1/p^j}⟩ congruent modulo ϖ^{i/p^k} and ϖ^{i/p^k} by ϖ_{ik} ∈ K_j of the same norm (Weierstrass invariance), and is the completed colimit over j of the Noetherian tube models (formulas (14)–(17)). Choose g_k in the completed coordinate base by Frobenius surjectivity, approximate it in A°_{j0}, and enlarge j ≥ k so f_{ik} ≡ T^{1/p^k}−g_k mod ϖ_j. This is the base-ring choice required by the Noetherian tube lemma.

Fix a finite coordinate stage A°_{a0}. Build the relevant filtered colimits of tube models at stages j ≥ a,k; each is faithfully flat over A°_{a0}, since A°_{j0} is finite free over A°_{a0}. Their p-adic completions remain faithfully flat over this fixed Noetherian A°_{a0}, by DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra:R03.1/faithful-flat-algebra-completion (p lies in its Jacobson radical). Apply this at every finite stage. The equational criterion now gives flatness over A°_∞0, since any finite coefficient relation descends to one stage; faithfulness follows since a finite expression 1 ∈ IC for a proper ideal I also descends to a stage, contradicting stagewise faithfulness. No completion theorem with a non-Noetherian base is being invoked.

Pass to the almost category: (·)_{!!} respects faithful flatness (PerfectoidSpaces:P0/lower-shriek-shriek-faithful-flatness), so the tube algebras' (·)_{!!} are faithfully flat; the completed colimit over i is faithfully flat, and the tubular description (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/kummer-tower-tubular-description) identifies it almost with Â°_∞∞.

Consequence: Â_∞∞ is faithfully flat over A[1/p] and g is a nonzerodivisor of Â_∞∞ (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/kummer-generic-faithful-flatness).

nodes.title: Purity of normalized Kummer extensions
nodes.statement: In the setting of PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/normalized-kummer-tower, for all j, k ∈ N ∪ {∞} the inclusion A°_{j0} ↪ A°_jk is pure. In particular, for j = 0 and k finite, A = W(k)⟦T_1,…,T_n⟧ is a direct summand, as an A-module, of the integral closure of A in A[g^{1/p^k}][1/p], and likewise after adjoining roots of unity and of the coordinates.

A°_∞0 is coherent, being a filtered union of Noetherian rings finite flat over one another. Let P be a finitely presented A°_∞0-module and N ⊂ ker(P → P ⊗ A°_∞∞) finitely generated, hence finitely presented.

Â°_∞∞ is almost faithfully flat over A°_∞0 (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/kummer-almost-faithful-flatness), hence almost pure (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/almost-pure-map), and so is A°_∞∞; thus N is almost zero and its annihilator I contains K°°_∞.

I is finitely presented, so I = I_j ⊗ A°_∞0 for an ideal I_j of some A°_{j0}; apply the Krull detection lemma (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/krull-detection-lemma) with R = A°_{j0} local, M = A°_{j0}/I_j, S = A°_∞0 and K = A°°_∞0 (idempotent) to get I_j = A°_{j0}, so N = 0.
For finite j, k, the finite extension A°_{j0} → A°_jk of Noetherian rings is pure with finitely presented cokernel, hence split (André B Lemme A.2.1(4)).

This gives the direct summand theorem for Kummer extensions of W(k)⟦T⟧ without the perfectoid Abhyankar lemma (André B §0.6).

nodes.title: Ramified almost flatness and purity modulo p^m for the Kummer tower
nodes.statement: Let A = W(k)⟦T_1,…,T_n⟧ and A ↪ B be a finite injective extension with B reduced and p-torsion-free, and g ∈ A ∖ pA with B[1/(pg)] étale over A[1/(pg)]. Let B° be the integral closure of Â°_∞∞ in the finite étale Â_∞∞[1/g]-algebra B ⊗_A Â_∞∞[1/g]; the map B ⊗_A S → B ⊗_A Â_∞∞[1/g] (S as in PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/flat-integral-model) factors through B°, and becomes an isomorphism after inverting pg. View Â°_∞∞ and B° as K°_∞[T^{1/p^∞}]-algebras through T^{1/p^h} ↦ g^{1/p^h}. Then in the setup (K°_∞[T^{1/p^∞}], T^{1/p^∞}K°°_∞[T^{1/p^∞}]), for every m ∈ N, Â°_∞∞/p^m → B°/p^m is almost faithfully flat, hence almost pure. Consequently, in the setup (K°_∞ + K°°_∞[T^{1/p^∞}], T^{1/p^∞}K°°_∞[T^{1/p^∞}]), S/p^m → (B ⊗_A S)/p^m is almost pure for every m.
hypotheses: For the purity of A ↪ B one may assume B reduced and p-torsion-free, even a domain with B[1/(pg)] Galois over A[1/(pg)] (Hochster's reduction); the Galois case of the Abhyankar lemma suffices.
If a ∈ A maps to p^m b in B, then b = a/p^m ∈ A[1/p] and is integral over A because B is finite. Normality of A implies b ∈ A, proving A/p^m → B/p^m injective.
proofSteps: Â_∞∞ is perfectoid (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/kummer-tower-tubular-description) and g is a nonzerodivisor with compatible roots in it (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/kummer-generic-faithful-flatness); B′ = B ⊗_A Â_∞∞[1/g] is finite étale over Â_∞∞[1/g] since B[1/(pg)] is étale over A[1/(pg)] and p is invertible in Â_∞∞.

Apply the perfectoid Abhyankar lemma (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.4/perfectoid-abhyankar-lemma (1)–(2)): B° is almost the integral model of the largest perfectoid intermediate algebra and B°/p^m is almost finite étale over Â°_∞∞/p^m; B′ is faithful over Â_∞∞[1/g] (A → B injective and Â_∞∞ flat), so the almost finite étale algebra is almost faithfully flat, and almost pure (PerfectoidSpacesPartII:RA.5/almost-pure-map).

For the corollary: almost zero has the same meaning in both setups and S is almost isomorphic to Â°_∞∞ there, so S/p^m → B°/p^m is almost pure, and so is S/p^m → (B ⊗_A S)/p^m, through which it factors.
acceptance: For g a unit the ramified almost setup reduces to the valuation setup and the almost-flatness assertion is ordinary almost purity over the resulting perfectoid base. One can also apply ordinary almost purity to the coordinate cover Â_∞0; this does not identify the freely adjoined g-root tower with Â_∞0.

This is the input that, with the Krull detection lemma and Hochster's Mittag-Leffler argument, proves the direct summand theorem in André B §§3.3–3.4 (owned by Direct summands and big Cohen–Macaulay algebras).
